page.title: Donald Knuth
page.desc: Born 1938. Author of The Art of Computer Programming (from 1968), creator of TeX (1978) and literate programming, Turing Award 1974, and source of the line about premature optimisation.
page.intro: Born 1938. Author of The Art of Computer Programming (from 1968), creator of TeX (1978) and literate programming, Turing Award 1974, and source of the line about premature optimisation.

synapses.text: The multi-volume work is the reference on algorithms and their analysis; Knuth pays a hexadecimal dollar for each error found.
"We should forget about small efficiencies, say about 97% of the time: premature optimization is the root of all evil" (1974).
He wrote TeX to typeset his books and proposed literate programming to write programs as literature.
